items.q: What happens if an item is out of stock?

c: If an item becomes unavailable after you place your order, we'll contact you via email or WhatsApp to offer alternatives. You can choose to wait for restock, select a different item, or receive a full refund.

items.q: What is your return policy?

c: We accept returns within 7 days of delivery for unworn items with original tags and packaging intact. Due to hygiene reasons, underwear, panties, and bodysuits cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged or defective.

items.q: How long do refunds take?

c: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, approved refunds are processed within 3–5 business days via bank transfer to the account you provide.

items.q: Is my payment secure?

c: Yes. Our website uses SSL encryption to protect your data. Payment is made directly through your bank's transfer channels, so your banking details are never shared with us. We only receive the payment receipt you upload.

items.q: What happens after I make a transfer?

c: After transferring, upload your payment receipt (screenshot or photo) at checkout. Once we verify the payment, your order will be confirmed and you'll receive an email notification. Verification usually takes a few hours during business hours.

items.q: How do I find my size?

c: with measurement instructions, size charts for bras, panties, loungewear and bodysuits, plus a quick bra size calculator. Take your measurements and match them to our charts for the best fit.

items.q: What if I'm between sizes?

c: If you're between sizes, we generally recommend sizing up for comfort, especially for bras and bodysuits. For a more fitted look, size down. You can also reach out via WhatsApp (

items.q: Do your sizes run true to size?

c: Our sizing is based on standard UK sizing. Different styles and fabrics may fit slightly differently — stretchy materials like lace and mesh tend to be more forgiving, while cotton pieces fit more true to size. Always check the product description for specific fit notes.

items.q: How do I create an account?

c: Click the user icon in the header and select "Register". You'll need your name, email, and a password. Benefits include order tracking, saved addresses, wishlist, and faster checkout.

items.q: I forgot my password. What do I do?

c: Click "Login", then "Forgot Password?" on the sign-in form. Enter your email and we'll send a password reset link. The link expires in 24 hours for security.

items.q: Can I shop without an account?

c: You can browse our products freely, but you'll need an account to complete a purchase. Creating one takes less than a minute and gives you access to order history, a personal wishlist, and faster future checkouts.
